com.wac.autocore.repository

Class Queries

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.repository.Queries

  • final class Queries
extends java.lang.Object
    Opens the connection, runs the statement and closes everything again, so each repository keeps only its SQL and its row mapping. A failed statement leaves here as DataAccessException. Each method has a twin that takes the connection from the caller instead, so several statements can be part of one transaction. The twin leaves the frame to whoever called it.
